title.value: On learning history-based policies for controlling Markov decision processes
title.justification: The title clearly defines the paper's core focus on developing policies through history-based methods for controlling Markov decision processes.
title.quote: On learning history-based policies for controlling Markov decision processes

extractions.description: The paper introduces a theoretical framework for studying reinforcement learning algorithms designed to control Markov decision processes using history-based feature abstraction mappings. It also develops an RL algorithm based on this framework and evaluates its effectiveness on continuous control tasks.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily focuses on developing a history-based learning framework and algorithms to improve reinforcement learning performance but does not directly address Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: In this paper, we introduce a theoretical framework for studying the behaviour of RL algorithms that learn to control an MDP using history-based feature abstraction mappings.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not address any direct aspect related to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development. Instead, it focuses on improving reinforcement learning techniques.
primary_category.quote: ...there has been little formal analysis of such history-based algorithms, as most existing frameworks focus exclusively on memory-less features...

primary_sub_category.justification: Since the paper does not relate to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development, no sub-category under the list applies.
primary_sub_category.quote: The rest of the paper is organised as follows: In Section 2, following a brief review of feature-based abstraction, we motivate the need for using history-based feature abstractions.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on abstract reinforcement learning models without direct implications for climate or ecological applications.
new_primary_category.quote: Reinforcement learning (RL) folklore suggests that history-based function approximation methods, such as recurrent neural nets or history-based state abstraction, perform better than their memory-less counterparts...

new_primary_sub_category.justification: No new sub-categories were necessary as the paper is not aligned with Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development themes.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: We present such a construction in the next section to develop an RL algorithm for learning a history-based state representation and control policy.
